items.text: Discoverability queue removed — no more post-onboarding queue chain or Tip X of Y bar; What's new still auto-opens when unread; layout and paste spotlights reset individually from Advanced → System → Tours & onboarding.
Dashboard post-onboarding — What's new, layout-nudge, and paste spotlight run directly again without a queue coordinator.

Post-onboarding chain hardening — What's new retries when blocked instead of skipping for the session; polling capped after ~30s; open-abort retries capped at 20; layout nudge reset from config runs the full chain again (not layout-only).
isModalOpen visibility — post-onboarding prompts only wait for actually visible overlays, not stale DOM or guided-flow-locked alone.
General config tour restored — first desktop visit to Config → General shows the overview tour again (Essentials / Advanced layers); reset from Advanced → Tours & onboarding → General.
Recoverable guided flow — stale tour DOM teardown, scroll-lock recovery, and watchdog when the card stays hidden; cache-bust on tour assets; settings search promo reschedules when the tour ends.
Guided flow stale tour cards — GuidedFlowGuard ignores invisible tour DOM so guided-flow-locked does not stick after a tour ends.
Guided flow invisible overlays — onboarding and feature-tour overlays use the same visibility check (not only config tour cards).

Layout nudge replay — reset from config queues a replay when no dashboard tab is open; dashboard init consumes the pending flag and runs the full post-onboarding chain; legacy discoverability-deferred session keys cleared.
Layout nudge reset feedback — clearer messages when the layout prompt shows immediately vs when you need to open or reload the dashboard (EN/NL/DE/FR).
Paste spotlight replay — reset from config queues a replay when no dashboard tab is open; dashboard init consumes the pending flag and runs the post-onboarding chain.
Settings search promo auto-start — confirmed-dismiss storage avoids false “seen” flags from focus-before-show; retry fallbacks; schedules after config load and when switching to General.
Settings search mobile resize — re-binds search listeners when you widen the config window after loading on mobile.
Settings search desktop→mobile resize — hides the search field and dismisses the promo when narrowing the config window.
Settings search promo during tours — waits until config tours finish instead of forcing after 45s; detects open What's new via AppModal overlay.
Reset settings search promo — Advanced → Tours & onboarding button replays the pulsing search field and speech balloon on desktop (Ctrl+Shift+K / Cmd+Shift+K vs Ctrl+K quick actions).

Config unsaved state — snapshot-based dirty tracking waits for categories to load before the baseline; autosaved settings (language, layout, low-risk toggles) clear the unsaved badge when nothing else changed.
Conflicting save feedback — All saved ✓ no longer appears alongside the unsaved badge; autosave and manual Save share the same dirty baseline.
Quieter save toasts — settings-only Save shows header confirmation only; the bottom-right “return to dashboard” toast stays for bookmarks, pages, categories, finders, and duplicate-URL warnings.
Search flow hint — only shows after onboarding is completed; hidden during first-run wizard; clears search-flow-hint-v2 when onboarding starts.
